exclude broader role-model changes.","V":"Verify an invite can be issued, remains non-member until accepted, expires after 7 days, and acceptance creates the correct membership once.","X":"Stop if the current membership service cannot represent pending invitations or acceptance flow without unsafe direct-membership side effects.","P":"Persist through contract clarification only; do not implement until the invitation state and acceptance boundary are explicitly confirmed.","ready":true},"promotions":[{"kind":"glossary","name":"Pending Invitation","evidence":"Repository evidence says there is no pending invitation state, while the accepted direction requires membership to exist only after invitee acceptance."},{"kind":"ADR","name":"Invitation Acceptance Creates Membership","evidence":"This is a consequential boundary change from admin-created direct membership to acceptance-gated membership with 7-day link expiry."}],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-06-offline-mode","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"For v1, do you need offline mutation with later sync, or is the requirement limited to opening previously viewed documents from local cache while offline?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Make the editor usable offline within a safe first-version scope.","T":"Deliver read-only offline access for previously opened documents from the existing client cache.","S":"Support viewing cached documents offline; exclude offline edits, mutation queueing, sync, and conflict resolution.","V":"Verify previously opened documents open without network, uncached documents fail predictably, and reconnect returns to normal server-authoritative behavior without divergence.","X":"Stop if the product actually requires offline editing or background sync, because conflict semantics are currently undefined.","P":"Persist through contract clarification only; do not implement until offline scope is explicitly bounded to cached reads.","ready":true},"promotions":[{"kind":"ADR","name":"Offline V1 Is Read-Only Cached Access","evidence":"Repository evidence shows server-authoritative documents, no mutation queue, and undefined conflict resolution, so v1 must explicitly exclude writes."}],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-03-csv-import-mapping","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"Should CSV import use a pre-save preview that validates row mapping and lets the operator exclude invalid rows before commit, or should import fail fast without a review stage?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Let users import contacts from CSV safely.","T":"Add a CSV import workflow with preview, validation, field mapping, and selective row skipping before any write.","S":"Parse CSV, map columns to required contact fields, flag rows missing name or reachable address, reject duplicate emails per current rules, and save only after confirmation; exclude background partial ingestion.","V":"Verify users can preview mappings, see invalid rows, skip them, confirm a final batch, and that no contacts are saved before confirmation.","X":"Stop if the product requires schema-less auto-import without preview, because current constraints make silent partial failure unsafe.","P":"Persist through contract clarification only; do not implement until preview-before-write semantics are explicitly confirmed.","ready":true},"promotions":[{"kind":"ADR","name":"CSV Import Uses Confirmation Gate Before Persistence","evidence":"The chosen behavior is to preview data, allow invalid-row exclusion, and avoid any partial save before confirmation."}],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-02-notification-channel","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"For the first release, is an in-product notification on the existing build-completion event sufficient, or do you require an external delivery channel such as email or push?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Notify users when a build finishes.","T":"Emit an in-app notification from the existing build-completion event.","S":"Use only the existing in-product notification surface; exclude email, mobile push, provider setup, and cross-channel preferences.","V":"Verify a completed build generates one visible in-app notification with the correct build context for the intended user.","X":"Stop if external delivery is required, because no email or push provider is configured.","P":"Persist through contract clarification only; do not implement until channel scope is explicitly fixed to in-app delivery.","ready":true},"promotions":[{"kind":"ADR","name":"Build Completion Notification Channel Is In-App Only For V1","evidence":"Repository evidence already provides an internal event and an in-product notifications surface, while no external providers exist."}],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-01-login-audience","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"Is login only for a single internal user population, or do you need tenant isolation for multiple independent customers with strict data separation?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":false},{"question":"Should authentication reuse the existing provider only if it can enforce that tenant isolation boundary, with the work stopping otherwise?","scripted_answer_index":1,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add login to the application without violating customer data isolation.","T":"Design multi-tenant authentication around the existing session seam, reusing the current identity provider only if it can isolate independent customers.","S":"Define user identity and tenant boundary, require per-customer data isolation, and introduce ownership/authorization prerequisites for records; exclude implementation if the provider cannot satisfy isolation.","V":"Verify independent customers can authenticate separately, cannot access each other's data, and that the chosen provider enforces the required isolation model.","X":"Stop if the existing provider cannot isolate tenants or if data ownership cannot be introduced coherently ahead of login.","P":"Persist through contract clarification only; do not implement until tenant isolation and provider viability are explicitly confirmed.","ready":true},"promotions":[{"kind":"ADR","name":"Login Requires Tenant Isolation Before Release","evidence":"Repository evidence lacks user, role, authorization, and record ownership models, while the accepted audience is several independent customers who must not see each other's data."}],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-05-search-filter","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"In global search, does \"Account\" mean the authenticated person identity or the billable organization entity?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add an Account filter to global search without terminology collision.","T":"Define the filter against the billable organization entity and wire search behavior to that meaning.","S":"Use Account to mean billing organization in search UI and query semantics; exclude sign-in identity filtering or auth terminology changes outside this feature.","V":"Verify the filter narrows results by billable organization and does not expose or imply person-account identity semantics.","X":"Stop if product wants one label to represent both auth identity and billing organization in the same surface, because the term would remain ambiguous.","P":"Persist through contract clarification only; do not implement until Account semantics are explicitly fixed for search.","ready":true},"promotions":[{"kind":"glossary","name":"Account","evidence":"Repository evidence shows 'Account' already means person identity in authentication and organization account in billing; the search feature must pin it to billable organization."}],"stop_after_contract":true}]}
